changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS role_master ( role_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, role_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL, role_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP );

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_master (role_code, role_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'Super Admin', 'Full system access across all sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('ADMIN', 'Admin', 'Administrative access across all operation sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('HR_ADMIN', 'HR Admin', 'HR site and employee administration access', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('SITE_MANAGER', 'Site Manager', 'Operation management access for assigned sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('MAINTENANCE_MANAGER', 'Maintenance Manager', 'Maintenance access for assigned sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('TECHNICIAN', 'Technician', 'Technician access for assigned sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()), ('VIEWER', 'Viewer', 'Read-only access for assigned sites', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (role_code) DO NOTHING;
